mintAuthority.summary: GHSm is minted CDP-style on Celo by depositing USDm as collateral in Mento V3 (a Liquity v2 fork); BorrowerOperations is an immutable contract with no upgrade path; the token owner is the Mento Timelock (2-day delay) whose sole proposer is the veMENTO DAO Governor.

controls.label: Mento BorrowerOperations (immutable CDP minter)
controls.capDescription: GHSm mints only against USDm CDP collateral; BorrowerOperations has no owner() and no EIP-1967 proxy slot. It is immutable.
controls.evidence: At Celo block 69291577, eth_getCode returned 46358 bytes for 0x8ec9A81871F816F1EF007a82293703057A943B8A; owner() returned empty; EIP-1967 impl and admin slots are zero, confirmed immutable, no upgrade path.

controls.label: Mento Timelock (GHSm token owner)
controls.evidence: At Celo block 69291577, GHSm owner() returned 0x890DB8A597940165901372Dd7DB61C9f246e2147; getMinDelay() returned 172800. hasRole(PROPOSER_ROLE, 0x47036d78bB3169b4F5560dD77BF93f4412A59852) returned true (MentoGovernor is sole proposer); hasRole(EXECUTOR_ROLE, 0x0) returned true (open executor, standard OZ TimelockController pattern).

review.evidence: At Celo block 69291577, GHSm owner() resolved to the 172800-second Mento Timelock and BorrowerOperations was confirmed immutable. At block 72127037, the GHSm EIP-1967 implementation slot resolved to StableTokenV2 implementation 0x434563b0...850e and the EIP-1967 admin slot resolved directly to the same Mento Timelock, which can replace mint-critical token logic after its two-day delay. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: cap or minter replacement runs through the enforced two-day Mento Timelock, the live full-composition Mento reserve feed provides continuous reconciliation, and no regulator or independent attestor is evidenced.
